env DELTAT_DB=$PWD/foo.sqlite

deltat entry import input1.csv

deltat entry import --replace-start=00:00:00 --replace-end=23:59:59 --dry-run input2.csv
stdout 'Replacing 2 entries'
stdout 'input2.csv:2: new task “Ohai”'
stdout 'input2.csv:2: update entry 019b78c9-0a80-7b57-a933-85252fe70e28 for task'

deltat timesheet --all --format=csv
cmp stdout input1.csv
